units.source_text: 我清楚地记得，昔日父亲动不动就愉快地谈起禅海和尚的事，可见父亲对和尚的敬爱之心。

en.t: I remember clearly that in the old days my father would often speak cheerfully about the monk Zenkai, which showed the deep respect and affection he felt for him.

units.source_text: 不论外表还是性格，和尚的确是属于男性的豪放的禅僧的典型。

en.t: In both appearance and character, the monk was indeed the very type of a masculine, free-spirited Zen priest.

units.source_text: 他身高近六尺，肤色黝黑，眉毛浓密，声音宏亮极了。

en.t: He was nearly six shaku tall, with dark skin, thick eyebrows, and an exceptionally loud, resonant voice.
